meta.title: Bidding after the window closes is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open a suitable existing closed event with an invited vendor.
Open the buyer's Responses view where participation and bid counts are shown.
Establish that the buyer's response state is rendered before the attempted bid.
Record the buyer-side participation count before the refusal attempt.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the closed event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Attempt a bid after the window has closed and require positive refusal evidence.
Return to the buyer's Responses view.
Verify the buyer response state still renders after the refused bid.
Assert that the buyer-side participation and bid count did not change.
